verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents first-party self-hosting as a single dependency-free binary you can run on any machine, bare metal or in containers. That lets a user keep data wherever they deploy it. For the managed cloud, the only sign of region choice is a community remark that the closest region to Australia is Singapore. No first-party docs cover region selection or residency guarantees. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of cloud region selection, a list of available regions, explicit data-residency or compliance commitments, and independent corroboration of residency controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: You can run it on any Linux, macOS, or Windows machine, on bare metal or in containers.
They wish the cloud had an Australian region, since the closest is Singapore.
